rule: One fraud report per transaction (ARN); a case can have several transactions
Card number is a token: no clear PAN in any field (search for Luhn-valid 16-digit strings)
on_failure: Block the file and alert security

rule: Fraud type and entry mode translate with T-01 and T-02
on_failure: Hold the record for the analyst

rule: Fraud reported date is on or after the transaction date
on_failure: Hold the record for the analyst

rule: Amount is positive and the currency is ISO 4217
Reported within the scheme deadline after the fraud is confirmed (deadline to confirm)
